title: Finite Q3 noncommuting cubic-multiplier order stress
question: For the actual finite Q3 weighted carrier, can q_x^3 A_f^(-3/4) and A_f^(-3/4) q_x^3 be interchanged, or must later Volterra and Duhamel estimates retain both orientations?
method: Reuse the hash-pinned finite Q3 edge, square and 2x3 graph fixture from EXP-001158, with oscillator dimension three, source pairs, and beta values copied into the new manifest.

For every declared source pair form the centered weighted energy proxy A_f, shift it to the positive finite-matrix floor, and evaluate the right product q_x^3 A_f^(-3/4), the left product A_f^(-3/4) q_x^3, and their commutator without assuming spectral commutation.

Check nonzero operator and Gibbs four-leg commutator norms on all 28 site rows, verify the antisymmetry identity and the operator/state triangle bounds, and retain the finite minimum as a manifest-threshold diagnostic only.
Reconstruct the graph, energy, spectral power and four-leg norms independently, then compile Lean R329 for an exact rational 2-by-2 order witness and the scope firewall.
finding: Primary 274/274 and independent 269/269 assertions pass on all 28 site rows and three beta values; the integrated verifier passes 16/16 and Lean R329 compiles. The primary operator commutator norm ranges from 0.00338289725875145 to 0.43291523575391017. The minimum state-weighted commutator norm is 0.0021578555824109526 at beta=0.5, 0.0037948440974383863 at beta=1, and 0.0060973316177080515 at beta=2. Every row exceeds the declared 1e-6 floors and satisfies both triangle checks.
decision_reason: The finite carrier is genuinely order-sensitive on every declared row, so a later proof may not replace the two Duhamel/Volterra orientations by one commuting expression. This closes a reusable finite orientation firewall and gives a bounded diagnostic, but the sampled positive minimum is not a volume- or cutoff-uniform lower bound and supplies no infinite-dimensional domain theorem.
boundary: Finite oscillator-dimension-three matrices on the declared edge, square and 2x3 graphs; no common-core operator-domain, actual positive-time history, source/beta/volume-uniform Cauchy, exhaustion, common-alpha, OS/KMS/GNS, gap, continuum, C6, Sector A or Pre-A conclusion.
next_action: Use both orientations in the smallest actual split-history Volterra estimate, then test whether a source/beta/volume-uniform bound survives; if it does not, register only the precise route-local obstruction and keep common-alpha open.
no_overclaim: This finite order-sensitivity result prevents an invalid orientation swap. It neither proves nor disproves the analytic cubic multiplier embedding or any thermodynamic QFT construction.
open: source/beta/volume-uniform direct D and delta-D Cauchy
gap, continuum, C6, Sector A and Pre-A

Operator and Gibbs four-leg commutator norms are separately checked against their two orientation norms by triangle inequalities.
The 28 rows and three beta values are finite samples; their positive minima are not asymptotic bounds.
